name: Solid sorbent capture by rapid temperature swing
applications: gas and oil field steam generators

source.note: IEAGHG review of current and emerging CO2 capture technologies, TCCS-10, June 2019, Task 1 TRL tables

principle: CO2 adsorbs onto a solid sorbent (amine-based or a metal-organic framework such as CALF-20) laid out as thin structured filters. The filters rotate through adsorption, steam regeneration and cooling zones in about a minute, so a small sorbent inventory handles a large gas flow.

process_steps.name: Adsorption on structured sorbent
equipment: rotary adsorption machine with structured filters

suppliers.name: Svante
suppliers.product: rapid cycle thermal swing adsorption with structured adsorbents

advantages: Up to 95% capture reported, with high-purity CO2 in about 60 seconds of cycle (NETL page)
MOF sorbent (CALF-20) binds CO2 physically, lowering steam demand, and tolerates O2 and acid gases
limitations: Largest units are still engineering scale; commercial-scale references pending

costs.metric: Cost of CO2 captured, Svante RC-TSA (power plant TEA basis)
costs.basis: Chevron/Svante project economics table for a nominal 550-MW(net) natural gas power plant retrofit: current R&D value $50/t CO2, target $30/t; TEA numbers validated from pilot-scale data; dollar year not stated

source.note: NETL Compendium of Carbon Capture Technology 2024, Chevron/Svante VeloxoTherm entry (FE0031944), Table 2 Carbon Capture Economics, p. 186

costs.basis: Current R&D value $70,000-80,000 per tonne-per-day of capture capacity; target $60,000-70,000/TPD; dollar year not stated

source.note: NETL Compendium of Carbon Capture Technology 2024, Chevron/Svante VeloxoTherm entry (FE0031944), Table 2, p. 186

costs.basis: Current R&D value $26-28/t CO2 including filter bed replacement and compression cost; target $20-23/t; dollar year not stated

costs.metric: Cost of CO2 captured, Svante VeloxoTherm at Linde SMR hydrogen plant
costs.basis: Linde engineering study for a US Gulf Coast SMR capturing 1,435,000 t/yr net CO2 (92% capture efficiency): current R&D value $78/t, target $65/t; study status projects $88/t CO2 for a 30-year project life with debt plus equity financing and $124/t for 15-year equity-only financing; dollar year not stated

source.note: NETL Compendium of Carbon Capture Technology 2024, Linde/Svante SMR engineering study entry (FE0032113), Table 2 p. 556 and status p. 556

costs.basis: Current value is market price of material $30-35/kg; target estimated bulk manufacturing cost $20-25/kg; dollar year not stated

performance.metric: CO2 recovery of VeloxoTherm RC-TSA process
performance.basis: Process parameter table: CO2 recovery 90-95% (current R&D value), target 95%; CO2 product at 95% purity and 150 bar; engineering-scale test ran at about 8% feed CO2 (10.5% dry basis) with flexibility over 4-14% CO2

source.note: NETL Compendium of Carbon Capture Technology 2024, Chevron/Svante entry, Table 1 p. 186 and technical content p. 185

performance.metric: CO2 capture efficiency, Svante VeloxoTherm design at Linde SMR hydrogen plant
performance.basis: Commercial-scale design for an existing US Gulf Coast Linde SMR capturing about 1,435,000 t/yr net CO2 with at least 90% reduction in direct CO2 emissions; flue gas flow 596,000 kg/hr; blue H2 at 99.97% purity

source.note: NETL Compendium of Carbon Capture Technology 2024, Linde/Svante SMR entry (FE0032113), p. 553 and Table 1 p. 554

performance.metric: Adsorption and desorption temperature of CALF-20 rapid cycle
performance.basis: Adsorption at about 50 degC and 1-1.1 bar; desorption (direct steam regeneration at slight vacuum) at 120-140 degC and 0.8-1.0 bar

source.note: NETL Compendium of Carbon Capture Technology 2024, Chevron/Svante entry, Table 1 Sorbent Process Parameters, pp. 185-186

performance.metric: Heat of adsorption of CALF-20 sorbent
performance.basis: Physisorption mechanism; equilibrium loading 1.7-1.9 g mol CO2/kg dry sorbent in 20% CO2/N2 at adsorption and 0.3-0.4 g mol CO2/kg after desorption; heat of desorption 35-38 kJ/mol CO2

source.note: NETL Compendium of Carbon Capture Technology 2024, Chevron/Svante entry, Table 1 Sorbent Process Parameters, pp. 185-186

performance.basis: Three-to-five-year lifetime without bed replacement; high oxidation resistance below 50 ppm SOx and NOx and very stable under direct steam regeneration

source.note: NETL Compendium of Carbon Capture Technology 2024, Chevron/Svante entry, sorbent make-up requirements, p. 186

performance.metric: Cycle time of rapid-cycle TSA process
performance.basis: Fast process cycle of less than 60 seconds in the segmented-bed Mark II VeloxoTherm (rapid-cycle rotary valve moving bed); temperature and relative humidity vary along the bed within the cycle

source.note: NETL Compendium of Carbon Capture Technology 2024, Electricore/Svante structured sorbent beds entry (FE0031732), p. 297
